svg.text: LLMOps Governance — raw customer data to an approved model, on AgentCore
lakehouse or teacher data → Qwen3-1.7B QLoRA → gates → evidence → a person decides · 7 harnesses · click any card
reads traces · reports · runs · spend
AUDIT PLANE — reconciles what was actually spent · cannot stop a run · read-only billing IAM
via harness-driver λ
gate fail → remediate (≤3)
escalations → conductor triage first · page human only if needed
OPERATIONS — runs on its own schedule, outside any run's lifetime · the sweep looks for spend nobody has claimed

g.text: sweep outcome · never a runs row

svg.text: 📣 SNS llmops-escalations (1 confirmed subscriber) is published by the harness-driver λ — escalate ·
page_human · flag_variance — not by the sweep, which only invokes it. 🔍 Macie job llmops-customer-data-pii
(SCHEDULED daily, scoped customer-data/) is read read-only by the data-prep harness, whose audit
must state "no Macie job covers this data" whenever none does.
DATA PLANE — S3 Tables (Iceberg) medallion · each step a Glue job the state machine runs and waits on
Silver rules: dedup_event_id · tolerate_drift · order_by_turn · strip_think · drop_toxic · redact_pii · decontaminate · near_dup · strip_ungrounded_ids · exact_dup_after_strip
each held to the generator's planted defects exactly · names found by Bedrock Guardrails · the extract is what finetune trains on
GOVERNANCE PLANE — the evidence goes where the approver looks · the pipeline never approves
after MonitorReport, before Complete (39 states) · a card that cannot be written still completes the run
the version page shows the card's metrics and hyperparameters · Unified Studio reads Silver and Gold through one IAM role
STATE — S3: runs/<run_id>/manifest.json · lakehouse/ reports + extracts · finops/rates · customer-data/
DynamoDB: runs + stage-events + tasks + cost-actuals + cost-estimates · AgentCore: shared Memory
skills mounted from MLOps-agent-skills — all 19 mounts across all 7 harnesses are s3: a pinned snapshot in the platform bucket (ensure_skills), so no harness reads GitHub at session start
network: all 7 harnesses run PUBLIC (no networkConfiguration); the VPC is built but no VPC harness variant ships · least-privilege IAM, no *FullAccess · TEST-PROVEN gates per phase
